shell_chrome_agent_state_idle: State of an agent in the right sidebar list: it is open and doing nothing.
shell_chrome_agent_state_needs_you: State of an agent in the right sidebar list: it waits for the person (approval or an answer).
shell_chrome_agent_state_working: State of an agent in the right sidebar list: it is working.
shell_chrome_corner_notice_dismiss: Accessible name of the × on a notification card in the corner: closes that card.
shell_chrome_corner_stack_hidden_count: Visible label of the fold row's button: how many notifications are hidden. {count} is a number.
shell_chrome_corner_stack_more_notificat: Accessible name of the row that folds the toasts that do not fit in the corner.
shell_chrome_corner_stack_show_fewer: Accessible name of the fold row's button while every notification is open.
shell_chrome_corner_stack_show_less: Visible label of the fold row's button while every notification is open.
shell_chrome_corner_stack_show_more: Accessible name of the fold row's button while some notifications are hidden. {count} is how many are hidden; the zero arm exists for the plural rule and does not happen on screen.
shell_chrome_crumbs_back_to: Tooltip and accessible name of the back arrow of the visit history. {place} is the worktree and tab it returns to, such as 'main › Terminal'.
shell_chrome_crumbs_branch_label: Accessible name of the branch chip in the breadcrumb bar. {branch} is the current branch name.
shell_chrome_crumbs_forward: Tooltip and accessible name of the forward arrow of the visit history when there is no place to name. The back arrow uses common_action_back.
shell_chrome_crumbs_forward_to: Tooltip and accessible name of the forward arrow of the visit history. {place} is the worktree and tab it goes to.
shell_chrome_crumbs_location: Accessible name of the breadcrumb bar (space, worktree, tab) at the top of the window.
shell_chrome_crumbs_switch_branch: Tooltip of the branch chip in the breadcrumb bar: opens the branch picker.
shell_chrome_inbox_bell_clear: Button in the bell's popover that removes every notification.
shell_chrome_inbox_bell_empty_hint: What arrives in the bell, shown when it is empty. 'Tasks' are what agents were asked to do.
shell_chrome_inbox_bell_empty_title: Title of the bell's popover when there are no notifications.
shell_chrome_inbox_bell_mark_all_read: Button in the bell's popover that marks every notification as read.
shell_chrome_inbox_bell_notification_set: Button in the empty bell's popover: opens Settings at the notifications section.
shell_chrome_inbox_bell_unread: Accessible name of the bell when some notifications are unread. {count} is how many.
shell_chrome_notifications: Name of the corner column where toasts and cards stack, and title of the bell's popover.
shell_chrome_right_dock_error_title: Title of the error card that replaces the right sidebar when it crashes.
shell_chrome_right_dock_right_sidebar: Accessible name of the hidden right sidebar that slides in from the window's right edge.
shell_chrome_right_toggle_hide: Tooltip and accessible name of the header button while the right sidebar is pinned.
shell_chrome_right_toggle_show: Tooltip and accessible name of the header button while the right sidebar is hidden.
shell_chrome_space_dots_projects: Accessible name of the row of project dots (one per space) in the title bar.
shell_chrome_tab_switcher_panel: Name of the project Panel tab in the tab switcher list.
shell_chrome_tab_switcher_recent_tabs: Accessible name of the recent tabs list that the tab switcher chord opens.
shell_chrome_window_controls_maximize: Tooltip and accessible name of the caption button that maximizes the window.
shell_chrome_window_controls_minimize: Tooltip and accessible name of the caption button that minimizes the window.
shell_chrome_window_controls_restore: Tooltip and accessible name of the caption button that restores a maximized window.
shell_chrome_window_controls_window: Accessible name of the group of caption buttons (minimize, maximize, close) on Windows and Linux.
shell_chrome_workspace_rail_atlas_crew_s: Tooltip of the rail button for Atlas Crew. {shortcut} is the key chord, spelled by the platform.
shell_chrome_workspace_rail_atlas_crew_w: Accessible name of the rail button that opens the Atlas Crew workspace.
shell_chrome_workspace_rail_crewmates_ne: Accessible name of the red badge on the Atlas Crew rail button. {count} is how many crewmates wait for the person.
shell_chrome_workspace_rail_ide_shortcut: Tooltip of the rail button for the IDE. {shortcut} is the key chord, spelled by the platform.
shell_chrome_workspace_rail_ide_workspac: Accessible name of the rail button that opens the IDE workspace.
shell_chrome_workspace_rail_workspace_sw: Accessible name of the rail at the window's left edge that switches between the IDE and Atlas Crew.
shell_chrome_workspace_rail_workspaces: First-run hint beside the rail's handle; the shortcut that opens the rail follows it.
